name: @x/desktop
description: aix — AI Engineering Mission Control & Desktop Platform
author: truongdq <truongdq.dev@gmail.com>

scripts.build:shared: tsup src/shared/security.ts src/shared/desktop-logic.ts src/shared/session-list.ts --format esm --out-dir dist/shared --target node22 && tsup src/main/desktop-hitl-channel.ts --format esm --out-dir dist/shared --target node22
scripts.build:main: tsup src/main/index.ts --format esm --out-dir dist/main --target node22 --external electron
scripts.build:preload: tsup src/preload/index.ts --format cjs --out-dir dist/preload --target node22 --external electron
scripts.build: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@x/desktop^... && pnpm build:shared && pnpm build:main && pnpm build:preload && pnpm build:renderer
